data.content_ref: inline:The target asserts that the Collatz conjecture would be settled by proving a lower bound on |2^m - 3^k| to rule out non-trivial cycles, but it fails to provide a causal mechanism for how this addresses the possibility of divergent trajectories (sequences that increase indefinitely). Ruling out cycles is only one half of the requirement to settle the conjecture; the target's proposed solution is insufficient to prove every starting value reaches 1.
